newsitem.title: USA: U.S. jet fuel prices weaken, tracking NYMEX drop.
newsitem.headline: U.S. jet fuel prices weaken, tracking NYMEX drop.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices weakened Wednesday tracking the drop in the NYMEX futures basis price, although little movement was noted in the differentials.
On the NYMEX, July heating oil futures fell 1.01 cents to settle at 51.44 cents a gallon.
U.S. Gulf 54-grade jet fuel for delivery on the Colonial Pipeline changed hands at 0.15 cent over the July NYMEX, up from even with the screen on Tuesday, traders said.
In New York Harbor, prompt 55-grade jet fuel traded at 2.25 cents over the July futures, at the high end of the Tuesday's trading range.
